description: Draws one glyph from the sprite the project serves and hides it from assistive technology, so the component that draws it owns the name. Absent a sprite or a glyph it renders nothing.

icon.description: Phosphor class names, a weight and a glyph such as ph-bold ph-plus. A string with no weight class draws the regular weight. Arena's own screens write ph-bold, and ph-fill for an active or selected state.
